name: Ouka Ootori Amatsu
source:
One of the Four Gods who rule Canterbury, she is the head of the kingdom's Astral Research Division. Ruthlessly logical, she will only derive conclusions based on hard data, instead of relying on nebulous concepts like the "gut feeling" of her compatriots Sumeragi and Glenfarth.

[Spoiler]Her name prior to the Catastrophe was Konohana Ouka. The director of the research team comprising the Kujo siblings, Izana and Sumeragi. 

Like her compatriots, she finds violence a sub-optimal solution to resolving an impasse. Nevertheless, she has spent a thousand years overcoming her weaknesses and dislikes. Her power is to increase her physical capabilities using crystallised Astral, to the point her power output surpasses even Glenfarth's. Her fighting strategy is to kill her foes using her fists, or to detach her body parts and detonate them like a suicide bomber (which doesn't impact her fighting ability as she regenerates the limbs almost instantaneously). [/Spoiler]
